positioning: Criteria entity render_per_world_light per signed spec v3 §10.1: reference-side A/B/C judging, two-run sha, world isolation, product side via Card H render_per_world_with_lights + WorldLightPoses, test-time 3.15 model dump under tests/support (not fixtures). GPU-free implementation; GPU case ignored until G-L2/G-L1 reference exists.

tests/render_per_world_light.rs.role: entity: reference npz decode/load, capture provenance self-check, [ignore] GPU case (A/B/C + two-run sha + world isolation)

tests/support/render_bvh/light.rs.role: 3.15 dump -> RenderFields/SceneState; Card H product assembly; criteria A/B/C pure functions; sha/isolation helpers

dump_provenance.model_file_note: dump `model_file` is a name string only; the .mjb is generated under target/ and not committed, so the field does not identify a committed file.

criteria_implementation.criterion_a: two cameras x three worlds strict bit-level: rgb max_byte_diff==0 & mismatched_pixels==0; depth bit-equal mismatched==0 & beyond_ulp==0; seg (id,type) equal; no allowlist / no tolerance
criteria_implementation.criterion_b: reference state.npz light_xpos/light_xdir f32 bits vs product-side WorldLightPoses (bit-verbatim pass-through, no FK/f64/re-normalization): 0 exceptions
criteria_implementation.criterion_c: reference-side self-computed: C1 cam-persp adjacent-world rgb max_channel|delta|>=1/255 px count; C2 cam-hinge depth bit-changed + seg pair-changed px count; thresholds ACCEPT=384 / MARGIN=576; pairs [(0,1),(1,2)]; camera attribution fixed (C1=cam0/cam-persp, C2=cam1/cam-hinge); diagnostics recorded only
criteria_implementation.verdict: any <384 -> NonDiscriminating; any <576 -> Insufficient; else PassMargin
criteria_implementation.two_run_sha: sha256 of rgb/depth/seg buffers across two product renders must be equal
criteria_implementation.world_isolation: change world1 geometry + light poses only: world0/world2 both cameras bit-identical, world1 at least one camera changes; not a substitute for A/B/C
criteria_implementation.gating: GPU case #[ignore]; forced --ignored run panics explicitly with 'not executed: reference missing (G-L1 capture pending)' (no silent skip); G-L2 frozen exe runs it for real

self_proof.not_executed_check: logs/not-executed-check.log (forced --ignored run: expected explicit failure with 'not executed: reference missing ...'; not a card failure)

boundaries.stop_clause_check: not triggered: the entity only uses the Card H public entry + existing src/ APIs; no kernel/ABI/src change needed

g_l2_dependency: G-L2 validation window depends on this entity + G-L1 capture reference; this card itself runs no GPU and makes no rendering claim.

non_claims.statement: Implementation + test-time dump only: no per-world light acceptance, no upstream-implementation equivalence, no discriminability-restoration claim, no rendering numeric conclusion. The entity must not be claimed as passing before the G-L2 frozen-exe run on the G-L1 reference.
